desc: frequency-control of legibility onset (frequency-tertile control); Zipf R2 + family-staging permutation at BOTH self-rank thresholds. ENV-BRITTLE per F-2 (R2 informational; onset L23 + staging perm_p are the robust load-bearing numbers).

value.note_raw: Raw variant is basis-independent (computed on vectors_raw).
value.headline: Affect-type staging survives frequency control at both thresholds (reactive resolve earlier than diffuse after removing zipf; p<0.05).
value.basis_trace: Inputs are the sha-gated canonical vectors (6de2e293), the model lens (lens_ingredients.pt = frozen gemma-2-27b W_U/LN/vocab), and English wordfreq. The Zipf R2 is OLS(onset~zipf) over ALL emotions -> family-independent, no taxonomy input.
value.perm_p_families_note: The family-staging perm_p uses a fixed REACTIVE/DIFFUSE affect-type grouping (a conceptual split, not the k-means partition); it does not enter the R2.
value.source: OLS(onset~zipf) over all emotions; wordfreq Zipf
